title: Section 45 Incontestability Rule
content: Life insurance policies cannot normally be questioned after three years except in cases of fraud.

title: Free Look Period
content: Policyholders have a free-look period of 15 days or 30 days for electronic and distance mode policies.

title: Anti Mis-selling Rule
content: Advisors must not promise guaranteed returns on market linked insurance products.

title: Mortality Charge Disclosure
content: Mortality charges must be disclosed separately in illustrations and policy documents.

title: ULIP Illustration Guidelines
content: ULIP benefit illustrations must display both 4 percent and 8 percent gross return scenarios.

title: ULIP Structure
content: ULIPs combine life insurance protection with market linked investment options.

title: Term Insurance Overview
content: Term insurance provides pure life cover with no maturity benefit in most plans.

title: Smoker Classification
content: Any tobacco consumption during the previous twelve months is generally classified as smoker risk.

title: Return of Premium Plan
content: Return of Premium plans return eligible premiums upon survival at policy maturity while providing life cover during the policy term.

title: Guaranteed Income Plan
content: Guaranteed income plans provide predefined benefits subject to policy conditions.

title: HLV Age Multiplier Below 35
content: Applicants below age thirty five may qualify for up to twenty times annual income based on underwriting guidelines.

title: HLV Age Multiplier 35 to 45
content: Applicants aged thirty five to forty five may qualify for up to fifteen times annual income.

title: HLV Existing Cover Adjustment
content: Existing life insurance cover may be considered when determining additional financial eligibility.

title: BMI Standard Classification
content: BMI may be used to determine standard, loaded, or medical underwriting decisions.

title: High BMI Risk
content: High BMI values may lead to premium loading or additional medical requirements.

title: Medical Examination Requirements
content: Applicants with elevated risk factors may require Tele Medical Examination, Full Medical Report, ECG, HbA1c and Lipid Profile testing.

title: Cardiac Family History
content: Parental history of bypass surgery or premature cardiac disease can increase underwriting scrutiny.

title: Diabetes Family History
content: Family history of diabetes is considered during risk assessment.

title: Mining Risk
content: Mining occupations are generally considered high occupational risk.

title: Commercial Aviation Risk
content: Commercial aviation professions may require additional underwriting review.

title: Offshore Drilling Risk
content: Offshore drilling occupations may attract special underwriting requirements.
